scope.manuscript: Entire chapter read, including four worked examples, every one of eight exercise prompts and complete solutions, teach-back criteria and five delayed-check answers.
scope.program: Full input, benchmark source, all preserved output, README, focused checker and author/source records read.
scope.independent_work: Recomputed each worked case and exercise from the prompts; separately derived outside cash/resource and ownership calculations using exact fractions without importing the benchmark or checker. scope.authority: Only this peer JSON written. No manuscript, shared-state, source-catalogue, hosting or publishing changes; no child agents.

financial_and_instructional_review: Residual common shares are stipulated. Capital, APIC, retained earnings, treasury contra-equity, cash, issued shares and outstanding shares are distinguished. Contributions and distributions remain outside profit; below-cost reissues use treasury APIC then RE under the specified cost convention.

Derived old-owner wealth change n(Np-V)/(N+n) directly from the unchanged-business-value assumption. Percentage dilution, book value, market value and prospective profit-per-share arithmetic are not conflated with reported EPS or actual valuation.

Control is separately stipulated, with power, variable returns and their connection discussed; ownership percentages are not applied as automatic consolidation thresholds. Separate legal entities, group reporting and cash availability remain distinct.

Acquisition worksheet removes the investment and pre-acquisition subsidiary equity, recognizes stated goodwill/NCI, and respects the change from the parent-only opening reporting perimeter to the group.

Post-acquisition worksheet removes all internal sales, unpaid internal balances, subsidiary dividend income and unrealized inventory margin. The cost identity c+zT-T+(T-c)(1-z)=zc is valid at both sold-fraction boundaries within the stated no-impairment model.

Downstream profit elimination belongs to parent owners; upstream elimination changes the subsidiary profit available for NCI attribution. NCI is an attribution within ordinary equity, not an additional expense. The shortcut NCI=(1-alpha)*closing S equity is explicitly bounded.

All exercise methods are introduced before use. The open audit prompt has concrete criteria and an illustrative answer. Supplied control/valuation facts, cash feasibility, legal distribution capacity and current standards compliance are appropriately separated.

limitations: Scoped peer review by another coding agent is not independent human academic or accounting certification.

Review establishes stated synthetic arithmetic, derivations, prompt/solution fit and inspected source scope. It does not establish real control, legal distributions, actual fair values or compliance with a whole current accounting standard.
Full gated IFRS normative texts were not accessed. Historical teaching sources and public summaries are used only within the explicit chapter scope.

The bounded lab and checker are not generic consolidation software. Tax, impairment, bargain acquisitions, step acquisitions, ownership changes and other excluded complexities were not reviewed as implemented features.
No browser, mobile, visual or print QA performed; coordinator retains structural integration, canonical acceptance and publishing.
